intrebari.titlu: What you want to know before you start

lista.a: Print-ready 3MF files, with the parts already oriented for the printer and laid out on beds. Alongside each export you get a production sheet in plain text, with the colour table, the assembly steps and a checklist to run before delivery.

lista.q: Do I need to know 3D modelling?
lista.a: No. You pick the letter, the font and the dimensions from panels, and the geometry generates itself. There are no sketches, constraints or feature trees like in a CAD program.

lista.q: When do I need a commercial licence?
lista.a: When you sell what you make with the app — prints, physical objects or files. For your own projects, for family or as gifts, the app is free and complete. The licence does not unlock features; it grants the right to sell and gives you a licence number that appears on the production sheet.

It is a way to back the development, not a licence. You get the token3d files to print yourself and a badge you can show in your renders. It does NOT grant commercial use: you stay in personal-use mode.

lista.q: Which printer does it work with?
lista.a: Any FDM printer. The export is standard 3MF, opened by Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer, PrusaSlicer and Cura. You choose the bed size in the app, and parts that don't fit are split across several beds automatically.
Yes. All generation runs locally, on your own computer. Nothing is sent to any server and you don't need a connection to work or to export.

A small engraved marking reading praktik3d.ro, on the new generators — not on the letter ones, which stay free of any marking. It is how we sign our work on a free export. With the commercial licence you replace it with your own logo, or remove it.

final.titlu: Free for you. Licensed, if you sell.
final.text: All eleven apps work right now, with no account and no install. For your own projects they are free. If you sell what you make with them, you need a Commercial Licence.

paginaHuse.descriere: A case compatible with iPhone, generated from the dimensions in Apple's public accessory documentation.

sectiuni.text: A 3 mm ring, ten minutes of printing. Put it on the phone and find out whether the fit is right before you spend a whole case. It carries the model and the clearance engraved on it, so four frames printed in one afternoon are not four identical rings.

Every model has its dimensions transcribed from Apple's dimensional drawings, with the source written into the file. Anything missing stays blank and the model does not appear in the list. Models not yet confirmed in the workshop are labelled “from Apple drawings, not verified physically”.

The case is built around the camera island, with a local protective lip, instead of raising the whole back. Measured on the pilot models: the case adds 2.40 mm over the phone's face, and the camera lip stands higher only where the camera is.
Solid, engraved pattern, perforated, engraved name or cut-out name. Perforated goes through the wall; engraved leaves it closed. The charging ring stays solid however dense you make the holes.

paginaHuse.nota: Compatible with iPhone. Magic3D is not affiliated with Apple. Model names are used only as a compatibility reference.
